resources.string: Shows DockIn\'s payment popup the moment a payment app (PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay, BHIM, Slice, CRED and others) says Payment successful. Reads only those apps, and only the amount and who you paid. Nothing leaves your phone.
Asks where the money went, right after you pay.
New LMS assignments, deadlines within a day, and absences Camu records.
